stem.text: There are two main classes of antibiotics, broad spectrum and narrow spectrum.
Broad spectrum antibiotics affect a wide range of bacteria, while narrow spectrum antibiotics affect specific types of bacteria.
Which uses of antibiotics may result in antibiotic-resistant bacteria?

items: a broad spectrum antibiotic given to reduce the effects of the influenza virus
a broad spectrum antibiotic to treat *Mycobacterium tuberculosis* in humans
a narrow spectrum antibiotic to treat diarrhoea and sickness in cattle
